newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged in listless trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against its U.S. counterpart after a day of listless trade on Friday, reflecting what dealers called a lack of rate-influencing news in the market.
The local unit finished unchanged at T$27.495 from Thursday's end. Turnover was an inactive US$99.5 million.
Trading interest was thin. "Is there a market today?" one dealer joked. "There are two-way interests, but as you can see both are extremely minor," he said.
The rate was expected to consolidate in the current range for next week. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
